description:
In this video I'm going to share with you five common traits of high-status communicators. 

PREORDER MY NEW BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect
FREE Communication Frameworks Training ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/hsc-frameworks

When you meet someone new, they create their impression of you based on two things:
1. Your visual image: this is what you wear and your body language.
2. Your vocal image: this is how you use your voice and the way you communicate.

And based on these two things people unconsciously determine your level of status and how they compare to you on the social hierarchy, which can lead people to either want to listen to you and hang on to every word you say or do the opposite. 

So in this video learn the five common traits of high-status communicators and the common traits of low-status communicators so that you can change the way you communicate your vocal and visual image so that people can start to listen to you and respect you more. 

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
